title: Internal derived Hom preserves distinguished triangles in each variable and commutes with shifts.
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a small category with a Grothendieck topology $J$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], and let $\mathcal O$ be a sheaf of commutative rings on this site. Write $\mathcal A=\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O)$ for its category of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and $\mathcal D=D(\mathcal A)$ for the unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], assuming this localization is available in the chosen universes. Let $H:\mathcal D^{\mathrm{op}}\times\mathcal D\to\mathcal D$ be the K-injective derived internal Hom $H(P,Q)=R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O}(P,Q)$ of [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. Then both of the following hold.

(1) For every $L\in\mathcal D$, the functor $F_L:\mathcal D\to\mathcal D$, $Q\mapsto H(L,Q)$, admits natural isomorphisms $F_L(Q[n])\cong F_L(Q)[n]$ for all $n\in\mathbf Z$, coherent with zero and addition of shifts, for which it is triangulated [def-weil-triangulated-category].

(2) For every $M\in\mathcal D$, the functor $G_M:\mathcal D^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal D$, $P^{\mathrm{op}}\mapsto H(P,M)$, admits coherent commutation with all integral shifts and is triangulated for that structure. Here the opposite triangulated category has shift $(P^{\mathrm{op}})[n]=(P[-n])^{\mathrm{op}}$; thus the shift comparison is equivalently $H(P[n],M)\cong H(P,M)[-n]$.

In each clause, triangulated means that the functor sends distinguished triangles to distinguished triangles using its stated shift comparison. No boundedness, finite-generation or perfectness assumption is imposed.

proof.text: Fix $L$. The shift and triangle clause of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-internal-hom-exact-restriction], applied in its second variable, gives the natural commutation $H(L,Q[n])\cong H(L,Q)[n]$ and preservation of distinguished triangles with these comparisons. Take this shift structure on $F_L$. Preservation of distinguished triangles is exactly triangulatedness [def-weil-triangulated-category], so this proves (1). The cited clause is for arbitrary objects of the unbounded category.

source.place: Tag 08JC (lemma-RHom-triangulated), applied through the existing ringed-site internal-Hom calculus node.

proof.text: Fix $M$. Apply the same clause of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-internal-hom-exact-restriction] in its contravariant first variable. It supplies the compatible comparisons $H(P[m],M)\cong H(P,M)[-m]$ and the reversed distinguished triangles, including their boundary maps. Since shift by $n$ in $\mathcal D^{\mathrm{op}}$ is shift by $-n$ in $\mathcal D$, put $m=-n$: the comparison becomes $G_M((P^{\mathrm{op}})[n])\cong G_M(P^{\mathrm{op}})[n]$. This is the same coherent shift structure expressed on the opposite category, and the reversed-triangle assertion is preservation of its distinguished triangles. By [def-weil-triangulated-category], $G_M$ is triangulated, proving (2). The first and second clauses together give the required conjunction of universally quantified assertions.

theorem ringedInternalHom_exact
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ringedSiteModules.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u}
    RingCat.{u})).obj R))] :
    (∀ L : (DerivedCategory (ringedSiteModules.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u}
    RingCat.{u})).obj R))), ∃ _ : ((Functor.curry.obj (derivedInternalHom.{u, w} J R)).obj (op
    L)).CommShift ℤ,
    ((Functor.curry.obj (derivedInternalHom.{u, w} J R)).obj (op L)).IsTriangulated) ∧
    (∀ M : (DerivedCategory (ringedSiteModules.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u}
    RingCat.{u})).obj R))), ∃ _ : ((Functor.curry.obj (derivedInternalHom.{u, w} J R)).flip.obj
    M).CommShift ℤ,
    ((Functor.curry.obj (derivedInternalHom.{u, w} J R)).flip.obj M).IsTriangulated) := by
  sorry
